# Trial material codes

A trial identity has three fields: family letter, preparation ticket and variant suffix. T-P18-c therefore means family T, preparation ticket P18, variant c. The suffix is local to that preparation and says nothing about a production body code.

Copy all three fields onto a specimen's accompanying card. A colour nickname is never sufficient identity. When a trial uses a named colour sample, retain the coded preparation identity as well. Experimental material codes do not certify performance or permit production use.
